'drop' removes the row under the no-verbatim-quote rule or because the adversarial verifier falsified it. 'section' moves a row between Sections A/B/C/D/E. 'note' is echoed into the final file's correction log. Every entry traces to a named verifier report (*.verify.md) in this directory.
